profile.headline: Information Technology Specialist at GBF Enterprises Inc
profile.summary:
Software engineer with experience in web technologies, ad tech, automotive, and mildly in video streaming. Took some time away from the software engineering world to develop skills in IT (CMMC for manufacturing) and CNC machining principles.

I've decided to come back to the software industry with renewed motivation, energy, and confidence. I look forward to new challenges and to be delighted by the creative solutions to the tasks encountered.

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
· Translated the shop's technological needs into an actionable, step-by-step plan to rebuild their IT infrastructure from endpoint firewall to network switches, individual workstations, servers, and even CNC machines via serial communication. 

· Translated Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) requirements into a Security System Plan (SSP), in order to work towards compliance with federal cybersecurity standards.

· Implemented architecture to gather evidence of compliance via log gathering, patch updates, alert response and changes to the system.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Support · Technical Services · Information Technology Infrastructure · Standards Compliance · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · CNC Manufacturing · Metrology

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to a comprehensive rewrite of a legacy codebase for ad formats, enhancing performance.  
• Analyzed millions of ad signals across data sources, validating improvements in video ads’ play rates.  
• Led the design and implementation of a system for rapid creation of custom ad formats using Java and React/TypeScript.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to architect an AI-enabled sports publisher Site Search application.
positions.insights: Skills: Ad Tech · TypeScript · React.js · Java · Python · Next.js · SQL · Snowflake · Engineering Leadership · Cross-functional Collaborations

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the repurposing and refactor of a monetized streaming platform for a new music streaming venture.  
• Implemented maintainable frontend development features using ITCSS, BEM, and TypeScript for improved code reuse.  
• Owned full feature delivery, collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve a successful BETA release.  
• Established code conventions documentation for Python and TypeScript, enhancing maintainability and design implementation.
positions.insights: Skills: Live Video Streaming · Django · Python · SQL · TypeScript · Engineering Leadership · Cross-functional Collaborations

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed frontend features for a transactions-based video-streaming platform serving millions of monthly users
• Worked on new venture fork of main site and spearheaded the frontend portion which led to Volume’s launch in 2021
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and performance optimization.
positions.insights: Skills: Live Video Streaming · Django · Python · TypeScript · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and deployed full-page custom layouts for client websites using .NET/C#, SQL, jQuery, and Bootstrap.
• Delivered quick turnarounds on client requests in conjunction with support team that required intimate knowledge
of our platform. Successfully balanced unplanned tickets with new feature work every sprint.
positions.insights: Skills: Automotive · C# · .NET Framework · jQuery · SQL
